title: 23rd Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/23/1/2025).

Question from Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas to the Minister of Construction, Housing and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: the N. Lhohi water and sewerage system has been under construction for a long time but is still unusable; when will the remaining work be finished and when can residents use the system?

Question from Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to the Minister of Construction, Housing and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: after it emerged that Housing Development Corporation tried to hand over plots to people not on the Hulhumalé plot list under the Binveriyaa scheme, were any documents needed to investigate this lost in the fire at the Housing Ministry?

First reading of the resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to gauge members' views on the Chair acting in ways that obstruct the Majlis's work, contrary to the Constitution and the Standing Orders.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Housing Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu Central MP Asma Rasheed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the housing minister about Lhohi's unfinished sewerage system and HDC's Binveriyaa plot handovers, introduced a resolution criticising the Chair's conduct, and continued debate on the Housing Bill.
